caption: The drawing depicts a person standing and dressed in elaborate historical clothing. The main figure is wearing a voluminous, full-length dress with prominent brown and beige vertical stripes or shading, and the garment includes a matching, cape-like shoulder covering edged with a lighter pink trim. The person holds a white muff in their hands at waist level. The head is adorned with a large, wide-brimmed hat that is primarily bright red with decorative elements in the same color, such as feathers or ribbons, extending dramatically upwards and outward from the top of the hat. The person's face has dark, curled hair that is partially visible beneath the hat and appears to feature a blue earring. A pink ribbon ties in a bow at the neck. To the right of the main colored figure, there is an unfinished graphite sketch of a similar figure wearing the same hat, dress, and muff, but without color or shading, and with drawn guidelines on the lower portion of the dress. The background is a plain, off-white color.
title: Doll
